summary: The comeback: Years after your fall, {open seat} or your old office is on the ballot, and you can file.
realLife: One life: In 2013 he won back his old House seat in a special election; the party's campaign committee pulled support after his ex-wife filed a trespass complaint. Another: After losing in 2020, two impeachments and a conviction, he won the presidency again in 2024. Another: After losing House races in 1988 and 1990 he published an apology for his negative ads, and won an open seat in 2000. Another: After losing races for district attorney, senator and governor in the 1970s, he won a Senate seat narrowly in 1980 when the incumbent retired.
gates: You lost, left or resigned an office on record.
